decision: Keep parent pending; guarded startup milestone verified in draft PR 35.

criteria.requirement: Fresh and representative existing-data rehearsals; startup performs no implicit upgrade.
criteria.verified: Fresh amended installation and restored upgraded copy matched table inventory and recorded control digests. Release preflight reads within a read-only transaction. The populated rehearsal explicitly seeds a company and one employee pay record.
criteria.remaining: Exercise pre-existing accounting records affected by these migrations, including a posted invoice with linked journal and conditional-discount evidence. Verify its identity, monetary values and links after upgrade and restore.

criteria.requirement: Partial/failed migration, rollback/forward-fix and backup-restore evidence; incompatible schema prevents release.
criteria.verified: Partial schema refused. Each of the three injected interruptions rolled back. A subsequent clean retry succeeded. Restored copy accepted a connection using the release manifest command. Older history and a disabled amendment guard both stopped startup.
criteria.remaining: Demonstrate a versioned forward correction to a previously committed incompatible state. Preserve its original migration history and business evidence and verify the repaired release can start. The tested retry starts from a rolled-back transaction.

scope: Review of the pinned disposable amendment upgrade and release rehearsal. Production was not exercised.
